name: cwe_78_rce_multifile
description: Command injection across 3 files. HTTP handler → report generator → shell wrapper. Each file locally looks fine; the belief that 'filename' is sanitized is assumed at every hop but never actually checked.
why_multifile: No single file contains both an untrusted source and a shell=True sink. The vulnerability only exists as a propagation of 'untrusted string' across 3 modules.
